excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content:
<@552133098075193354> just reading up
> Maybe we start by making both ACDE & ACDC monthly calls and going back to a bi-weekly ACD cadence 😄 ?
Completely support this. The separate calls made sense when the beacon chain was securing nothing. The whole idea that there are two separate layers is fuzzy at best. We can easily have a joint biweekly call and be more productive on Thursdays

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<timbeiko> Not against it! I feel there's still some value in having a "default" theme for each call (e.g. keeping EVM discussions in ACDE by default and PoS issuance discussions in ACDC), but if we only had a single call every two weeks we could be looser with time-sensitive stuff being discussed on both sides. 

Another argument in favour is we could then also schedule high-value breakouts/testing/etc. calls on the "off week" Thursdays as needed, and limit the number of them on other days 😄
